questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I was very motivated on discovering other agricultural systems, for example vineyards, than the ones I was familiar. In addition, I am very focus in Plant pathology, and this opportunity gave me the chance to learn extensive theoretical and practical knowledge. Interecting with researcher, PhD students and other Master students is always enriching and it the oportunity to debate and learn from them.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Easy. The academic staff at the University of Florence was always providing me with precise and easy available information.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: The asistance came from my supervisor and mentor at the host university. They were always predisposed for any inquiry I could have.

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I used facebook groups of students.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: First of all, some universities do not offer the chance of on campus accomodation. Living off campus gives you the chance to interact more with the local culture and people. In my opinion, it is a very nice integration way.

questions.answer: Every form I needed to fill was easily provided by the internation office at the host university.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The staff was always available to answer any question which could raise.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Always contact the internation office. They are there to answer your questions.
